text: Medic three responding to a 72 year old male, family called for sudden weakness and trouble speaking.
On exam he has an obvious right sided facial droop and his speech is slurred, word finding difficulty.
Right arm drift is present, grip is weaker on the right, cincinnati stroke scale is positive on all three.
Last known well was at seventeen fifty, his wife says he was completely normal when she left the room.
Vitals heart rate 78, blood pressure 176 over 94, SpO2 96 percent, respiratory rate 16, blood glucose 112.
I asked about blood thinners, family is not sure, we have no medication list and no allergy information yet.
Suspected acute stroke, this is a time critical transport, acuity level two.
Pre notifying the stroke center, ETA eleven minutes, about nineteen hundred hours.
